screens.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup edit. Edit this GuildStock Spanish WoW addon concept while preserving its existing dark modern fantasy style, fine gold frame, typography, top tabs, neutral crate emblem, proportions and sharp legible labels. Remove the green status dot and the phrase 'Sincronización automática de hermandad' from the bottom footer entirely. Do not replace it with another status or control. Only bags; no bank, publish buttons or manual sync. In the left sidebar, underneath the heading 'PROFESIONES', add 'Todas las profesiones' as the FIRST profession option with a small neutral crossed-tools icon. Keep the specific profession options below it. Keep 'Para mis profesiones', 'Todos los materiales', 'Favoritos' as the upper navigation group. There must be NO profession filter dropdown above the middle material list; profession selection exists only in the sidebar. Keep the search field. Adjust spacing to fit without clipping. Screen: Todos los materiales selected. Preserve the selected Barra de cobre and all four player rows and exact four columns 'Jugador', 'Bolsas', 'Última conexión', 'Susurrar'. Each player row keeps its own Susurrar button; Aldren and Mirel online have gold enabled buttons, Brannoc and Elowen offline have gray disabled buttons. Todas las profesiones is the selected profession option. Delete the now empty footer bar and extend the list/content panels downward to use that area. No footer status indicator. Keep the tiny outside-frame caption 'Concepto visual · Datos de ejemplo'. This is a focused layout correction, not a redesign.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create the final 'Mi inventario' screen for GuildStock, matching the supplied reference's dark modern WoW aesthetic, thin muted gold frame, crate logo, Spanish typography and window proportions. Preserve top title GuildStock, subtitle Materiales de hermandad, top tabs Materiales, Mi inventario, Ajustes, close X. Select Mi inventario top tab. Below tabs ONE FULL-WIDTH CONTENT PANEL, no sidebar or profession navigation. Large heading 'Mi inventario', quiet description 'Materiales de profesión en tus bolsas'. Full-width search field 'Buscar en mis bolsas...'. Clean read-only table with exactly TWO columns: 'Material' and 'Bolsas'. Six sample rows with small item icons: Barra de cobre | 40; Mineral de cobre | 12; Paño de lino | 24; Piedra burda | 8; Flor de paz | 6; Polvo extraño | 3. Align quantities neatly. Below table quiet note 'Cantidades de tu personaje actual.' Leave comfortable breathing room. Absolutely no bank or total columns, no publication or offer controls, no sync label or indicator anywhere in footer, no refresh or manual-sync buttons, no whisper actions on own inventory, no extra cards. No footer bar. Small outside-window caption 'Concepto visual · Datos de ejemplo'. Keep original image landscape size and visual fidelity; realistic implementable WoW addon mockup, not a web page.
